title: Verve exercise catalog
description: Version 1 of the bundled, curated exercise catalog. Display labels live in separate locale JSON files.

$schema.description: Optional path or URI to this schema for editor support.

source.description: Permanent identity of our catalog, for example verve. This is not the upstream dataset name.

muscles.description: All detailed muscle codes referenced by this catalog.

muscle_groups.description: Bundled default display groups. Group codes must be unique.

exercises.description: Concrete exercise variants. Exercise codes must be unique.

revision.description: Full immutable upstream Git commit, independent of our catalog checksum.

muscles.description: Complete default member set. Each code must exist in the root muscles array. An empty group is valid.

is_active.description: Omission means true. Set false to retain a retired exercise explicitly.

primary_muscles.description: Complete primary assignment set. Each code must exist in muscles and must not also occur in secondary_muscles. May be empty.

secondary_muscles.description: Complete secondary assignment set. Each code must exist in muscles and must not also occur in primary_muscles. May be empty.

upstream_id.description: Optional exercise ID at the root upstream revision. Omit for our own entries. Never used as the database identity.
